premises.text: Multimodal overseas shipment visibility consolidates transport-provider API/EDI data with independent satellite/GPS/IoT tracking because consolidation alone is limited in data quality
premises.evidence_span: consolidation alone is limited in terms of data quality. So we pair providers' information with real-time and reliable tracking

premises.text: Data science predicts arrival times using external factors (traffic/events) and sends smartphone alerts to ops teams when delays exceed a threshold
premises.evidence_span: we use data science to predict times of arrival by taking into account external factors like real-time traffic or events. And we send alerts to operational teams directly to their smartphone

premises.text: Analytics objectify carrier/shipment performance with the goal of reducing transit time and financed inventory
premises.evidence_span: the analytics feature objectifies performance. The goal is to reduce, as much as possible, the transit time

value.text: Shift supply chains from reactive to predictive—anticipation, reliability (lower safety inventory), and proactive customer information
value.evidence_span: We change the supply chain from reactive to predictive

causal_links.evidence_span: It consolidates multiple transport providers into one single stream
anticipation, to secure production lines by sending alerts to operational teams
reliability, to reduce safety inventories and save up to several million euros a year
